maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from new MasterCraft performance towboats (XStar, X Family, XT, NXT, ProStar) sold through dealers; first-time purchases.

publicly_funded.reason: Recreational boats sold to private consumers via dealers; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own boat brands and new models; acquisitions (e.g., Aviara, NauticStar) are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Discretionary recreational boats; buyers can choose other boat brands, and nothing operationally critical depends on it.
